{{Quote|Oh, no! It's the ''Avenger''!|[[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] technician, trying to escape while carrying the [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]|<ref name="Xwing-Alliance" />}}
The '''''Avenger''''', full name '''CVS 1401 ''Avenger''''',<ref name="SpecPlate" /> was a prestigious [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
===Development===
{{Quote|Sir, we're having trouble apprehending Moff Kalast. His star destroyer is one of the newer models, and we've been unable to succesfully engage him before he enters hypersapce|An Imperial officer to Grand Moff Tarkin, regarding the now rebel controlled ''Avenger''|<ref name="EaW" />}}
It was developed by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], with [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]], and [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] providing secondary contracting elements to its design. Its basic blueprints, or SpecPlate, had been drawn up by [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] and designed by [[Louis Solis]]. It had been commissioned by [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]] under special orders. It was developed by a team under the [[Imperial Navy Research, Development and Engineering Center]], composed of the Chief Naval Architect [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]]; Chief Project Engineer [[J. Johnston]], Senior Structural Engineer [[C. Cantwell]]; Senior Construction Designer [[S. Gawley]]; Chief Design Engineer [[R. McQuarrie]]; and Systems Engineering Director [[D. Beasley]]. Its keel had been laid, with it undergoing a naming ceremony shortly thereafter. Afterwards, it underwent the stepping of the mast, and was launched. It eventually underwent christening of the name ''Avenger'', and had a pre-commission crew man the ship to undergo various trials. It then underwent dock trials, fast cruises, space trails, and contractor fitting out. Eventually, it was delivered to Captain Lorth Needa, and was fitted with an active service crew alongside it undergoing a shakedown cruise before it underwent official commissioning. Upon completion and undergoing its official commissioning ceremony, it had a commemorative SpecPlate placed on the bulkhead until the event where it was stricken from the registry.<ref name="SpecPlate" />

===Imperial Period===
{{Quote|Sir, we have a priority signal from the Star Destroyer ''Avenger.''"<br />"Right.|An unidentified Imperial Officer and Firmus Piett|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:Arrest_over_Atzerri.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''Avenger'' assisting rebel forces at Atzerri under the command of Moff Kalast, prior to its recapture by the Empire.]]
One of the ''Avenger's'' earliest missions was the [[Defense of the Karinne|attack]] on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Karinne]]'', carrying a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] delegation to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The ''Avenger'' launched three flights of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] against the ''Karinne'', and entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The intervention of two Alliance [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] saved the diplomatic vessel.<ref name="xwing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the ''Avenger'' was under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]]. When he betrayed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Moff used his ship to secretly support the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. But after giving secret informations about the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to the rebels, his identity was discovered. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] tracked Kalast to [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] and other [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] but the Moff and the ''Avenger'' always escaped. Eventually Vader managed to capture the ''Avenger'' thanks to an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]]. The ship was severely damaged in the [[Capture of Kalast|battle]] and Kalast forced to surrender. The ''Avenger'' was subsequently returned to Imperial service.<ref name="EaW" />

At an unknown point, the ''Avenger'' was presented with the [[Superior Service Award]], the [[Legion of Merit]], the [[Valor Under Fire Citation]], the [[Combat Victory Accreditation]], and the [[Meritorious Service Award]] by the [[Commander Fleet Operations]].<ref name="SpecPlate" />

[[File:AvengerChaseFalcon-ST.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''Avenger'' pursues the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].]]
As early as [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the ''Avenger'' was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]]. Under Needa's command, the ''Avenger'' earned a reputation for subjugating planets in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], participating in the subjugation of over 436 worlds.<ref name="SWTSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>

After the discovery of an Alliance intelligence facility on [[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]], the ''Avenger'' participated in the brutal [[Battle of Dankayo|subjugation]] of the world. Alongside the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] and [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']], the ''Avenger'' executed [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] against Dankayo, incinerating its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and reducing its surface to slag.<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>

Eight months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ship [[Battle of the Poln system|fought]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s forces in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] as part of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]].<ref name="CoO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Rebel agents destroyed an Imperial depot that contained a large number of [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] intended for shipment to the ''Avenger''.<ref name="SWG:OMB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Rebel|Orbital Mines Bad}}</ref>

<div style="float: right">[[File:AvengerLooms-ESB.png|thumb|180px|The ''Avenger'', pursuing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] out of the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], a task which gained it and its crew a reputation for persistence.]]</div>
The ''Avenger'' was later reassigned to [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]. It was one of the ships of the Squadron that launched groups of [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] into remote reaches of space, carrying out Darth Vader's orders to find the new [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel Base]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], or the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Freedom's Winter">{{ESBRadio|Freedom's Winter}}</ref>

The starship's functions had been restored by the time that the ''Millennium Falcon'' departed from the planet during the Rebel evacuation.<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> The ''Avenger'' unsuccessfully pursued [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] fast [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], a failure which resulted in Needa's execution by Vader. Nevertheless, despite Needa's failure, the ''Avenger'' gained a reputation from the chase as it managed to continuously pursue the ''Millennium Falcon'' past the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] while other ships in Death Squadron lagged far behind.<ref name="ESB" />

During the [[Battle of Kothlis]], the ''Avenger'' arrived alongside the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] to disrupt a Rebel transfer with [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] agents to acquire the [[Death Star II plans]]. The ''Avenger'' captured the CR90 corvette [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']], which held the battlestation plans. However, the ''Avenger''{{'s}} attempt was in vain, as the crew escaped with the plans and delivered them to the Alliance.<ref name="Xwing-Alliance" />

When Vader arrived at the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] to put its construction back on schedule, his [[ST 321/Legends|personal shuttle]] was launched from the Avenger.<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref><ref name="Insider105">{{InsiderCite|105|25 Years of Return of the Jedi!|25 Years of ''Return of the Jedi''!|reprint=1}}</ref> The ''Avenger'' remained with Vader's Death Squadron and served as a communications ship during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CCG-Avenger" /><ref name="Insider105" />

===Operation Shadow Hand===
{{Quote|The ''Avenger'' has achieved hyperspace terminus, sir. The fleet is assembled. We are ready to annihilate the planet on your command!|An [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunner]] to [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]]|<ref name="DE2" />}}
The ''Avenger'' survived the Battle of Endor and later fought during the [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. Under [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]], the ship led the Imperial fleet in the [[Battle of Balmorra]].<ref name="DE2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although first seen in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] wasn't introduced until [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

[[File:ILMAvengerpublicityphoto.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An ILM publicity photo of the ''Avenger'' model]]
The [[Industrial Light & Magic]] model of the ''Avenger'' used in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] was 2.59 meters long and detailed with thousands of parts from model kits.

"[[Freedom's Winter]]" ([[1983]]), the first episode of [[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]], depicted Captain Needa aboard the ''Avenger'' overseeing the launch of the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] that discovered [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="Freedom's Winter" /><ref name="The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization">[[The Empire Strikes Back: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''The Empire Strikes Back'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> ''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' ([[1989]]) followed the radio drama, identifying the ''Avenger'' as the Star Destroyer that launched the Hoth probe. A [[Hoth Limited]] card in the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]] ([[1996]]) later contradicted this, introducing the ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'' as the Star Destroyer that carried out the operation. The ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and the PC program ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' (both [[1998]]) followed the card game and named the ''Stalker''. Further adding to the confusion, ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'' (also 1998) identified the ship as the ''Avenger''. Attempting to clarify the discrepancy, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ([[2009]]) states that both ships were responsible for deploying probe droids, without stating with certainty which ship is seen in the film.<ref name="Atlas" />

''Star Wars: Behind the Magic'' also identifies the ''Avenger'' as the Star Destroyer that launched Vader's shuttle at the beginning of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].

In the 6th mission of Battle 4 of ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', "Protect Imperial Computer", one bonus objective is to destroy the Avenger.
